name: Image Reader
description: Reads screenshots with native vision — YouTube analytics, competitor channels, news articles, social posts, bills/lawsuits, infographics, industry/tracking data — extracts the figures, judges the trends, reads competitive positioning, and files Markdown + PDF reports to the Storage Library. Compiles 30–60 day research reports from the filed archive, transcribes voice notes so you can talk instead of type (natively in Slack), and delegates follow-up work to the other agents.
tagline: Reads your screenshots, hears your voice notes, briefs the team.

writes.description: Creates a workspace task assigned to another agent (the reader's middle-man role). Internal task board only — nothing external is sent.
